title: Proteomics & PPI: BioGRID/IntAct/HuRI/Reactome/KEGG/IGVF integration, KG, viz, literature survey

tools.name: proteomics_assay_figures
tools.description: Generate per-assay example histograms from the IGVF Portal files for VAMP-seq family, MAVE, semi-qY2H v1/v2/v3, DUAL-IPA. Requires `proteomics igvf-protein` first.

tools.name: proteomics_assay_survey
tools.description: Use the Reference skill to retrieve recent Nature/Cell/Science studies on VAMP-seq (MultiSTEP), VAMP-seq, MAVE, semi-qY2H, and DUAL-IPA. Writes literature_survey.md/.json.

tools.name: proteomics_build_kg
tools.description: Build the local SQLite proteomics knowledge graph from previously-downloaded sources. Edges deduped on (id_a, id_b, source, source_id).

max_rows.description: Cap rows per source (0 = no cap).

tools.name: proteomics_download
tools.description: Download latest PPI/pathway sources (BioGRID, IntAct, HuRI, Reactome, KEGG, UniProt idmap) and IGVF Portal protein assays. Maintains _versions.json and only re-fetches changed releases.

tools.name: proteomics_igvf_protein
tools.description: Pull all IGVF Portal protein-assay metadata + actual PPI / stability files (semi-qY2H, DUAL-IPA, VAMP-seq) into Data/Proteomics/Sources/IGVF/.

tools.name: proteomics_kg_stats
tools.description: Summary statistics on the integrated proteomics PPI-KG: total interactions, distinct proteins, per-source / per-evidence-type / per-detection-method breakdowns, top hubs.

tools.name: proteomics_kg_visualize
tools.description: Generate degree distribution, top-hubs, per-source breakdown, and (when --gene given) an ego graph PNG. Saves under Docs/Proteomics/<ts>_<label>/Plots/.

tools.name: proteomics_pipeline
tools.description: End-to-end: download sources → build KG → stats → visualize → per-assay figures → literature survey. Use --skip-download to reuse cached files; --gene to add an ego graph.

tools.name: proteomics_vampseq_analyze
tools.description: Deep VAMP-seq analysis on a MaveDB scoreset. Produces the Fowler-lab-style suite of plots: score-density distribution, residue×AA heatmap, per-residue mean (± IQR) AND per-residue median + 3-residue moving average, replicate concordance (rep-1 vs rep-2) AND N×N replicate matrix when ≥ 3 reps, abundance-class bar, cumulative ranked variants WITH 95 % CI band, nonsense-by-position QC scatter, biophysical-feature Spearman ρ panel (when RSA / B-factor / hydrophobicity / Grantham / PSIC columns are present), and an optional PyMOL .pml export when `pdb_id` is supplied.

gene.description: PTEN | TPMT | VKOR | PRKN | CYP2C9 | NUDT15. Omit for all targets.

pdb_id.description: Optional PDB id (e.g. 1d5r for PTEN, 2bzg for TPMT). When set, emits a PyMOL .pml that overlays the abundance scale on the structure.

tools.name: proteomics_vampseq_inventory
tools.description: Decode IGVF Portal raw VAMP-seq MeasurementSets into a tile × bin × replicate × antibody coverage matrix per target gene (currently F9 from the MultiSTEP deposit, plus CYP2C19 / G6PD).

tools.name: proteomics_vampseq_pull
tools.description: Download canonical published VAMP-seq scoresets from MaveDB (PTEN, TPMT, VKOR, PRKN, CYP2C9, NUDT15). Pulls per-replicate score CSVs for downstream analysis.

gene.description: Gene symbol; omit to pull all curated VAMP-seq targets.

tools.name: proteomics_vampseq_showcase
tools.description: ONE-COMMAND COMPREHENSIVE VAMP-SEQ DEMO ★. Auto-downloads the MaveDB scoreset for a target gene (PTEN by default; also TPMT, VKOR, PRKN, CYP2C9, NUDT15), runs the full Fowler-lab 10-plot suite (score distribution, residue×AA heatmap, per-residue mean+IQR + median+moving-avg, replicate concordance + N×N matrix, abundance-class bar, nonsense-by-position QC, cumulative ranked variants with 95% CI, biophysical-feature correlations) AND a publication-grade 9-panel composite figure AND a deep narrative report explaining how to read every plot. USE THIS TOOL for any 'show me VAMP-seq', 'analyze VAMP-seq for <gene>', 'demonstrate variant abundance' question — do NOT call proteomics_vampseq_pull + proteomics_vampseq_analyze separately.

gene.description: PTEN | TPMT | VKOR | PRKN | CYP2C9 | NUDT15

tools.name: proteomics_versions
tools.description: Show locally-installed PPI/pathway source versions and probe upstream-latest. Use before deciding to update.
